datasets.name: ds_top_spaces
datasets.displayName: Popular Activity - Most Active Genie Spaces
queryLines:
-- Most Active Genie Spaces
WITH genie AS (
  SELECT
    space_id,
    genie_link
  FROM genie_event_detail
  WHERE action = 'Create Space'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  e.space_id,
  e.space_name,
  g.genie_link,
  COUNT(*) as ask_question,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.dbx_user) as unique_user,
  MIN(e.event_time_local_tz) as first_activity,
  MAX(e.event_time_local_tz) as last_activity
FROM
  genie_event_detail e
LEFT JOIN
  genie g
USING
  (space_id)
WHERE
  e.action = 'Ask Question'
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY ask_question, unique_user;

datasets.name: ds_user_activity
datasets.displayName: Popular Activity - Top Users by Activity
queryLines:
-- Top Users by Activity
-- Change <insert user group here> before deploying.
SELECT
  workspace_id,
  TRUNC(event_time_local_tz, 'MM') as month,
  dbx_user_groups,
  case
    when array_size(filter(dbx_user_groups, x -> x == 'users')) == 1 then true
    else false
  end as is_users,
  case
    when array_size(filter(dbx_user_groups, x -> x == '<insert user group here>')) == 1 then true
    else false
  end as is_<insert user group here>,
  dbx_user,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN
        action_name IN (
          'createConversationMessage',
          'genieCreateConversationMessage',
          'genieStartConversationMessage'
        )
      THEN
        1
    END
  ) as questions_asked,
  COUNT(DISTINCT space_id) as spaces_used,
  MIN(event_time_local_tz) as first_seen,
  MAX(event_time_local_tz) as last_seen,
  DATEDIFF(MAX(event_time_local_tz), MIN(event_time_local_tz)) as active_span_days
FROM
  genie_event_detail
WHERE
  action = 'Ask Question'
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  user DESC;

datasets.name: ds_group_comparison
datasets.displayName: Popular Activity - Questions by User Group
queryLines:
/*
 Questions by User Group:
  - Users in both groups counted in each.
  - To modify group, update 'base' and 'pivoted' clauses to capture the user groups you want to compare against.
  - One of the groups that is compared is currently 'users'. Feel free to add or change based on your specific scenario.
*/
WITH
    base AS (
        SELECT
          workspace_id,
          dbx_user_groups,
          dbx_user,
          space_id,
          event_time_local_tz,
          CASE
            WHEN array_contains(dbx_user_groups, 'users') THEN true
            ELSE false
          END as is_users,
          CASE
            WHEN array_contains(dbx_user_groups, '<insert user group here>') THEN true
            ELSE false
          END as is_<insert user group here>
        FROM
          genie_event_detail
        WHERE
          action = 'Ask Question'
    ),
    pivoted AS (
        SELECT
          'Users' as dbx_user_group,
          dbx_user,
          space_id,
          TO_DATE(event_time_local_tz) as usage_date,
          event_time_local_tz
        FROM
          base
        WHERE
          is_users = true
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          '<insert user group here>' as dbx_user_group,
          dbx_user,
          space_id,
          TO_DATE(event_time_local_tz) as usage_date,
          event_time_local_tz
        FROM
          base
        WHERE
          is_<insert user group here> = true
)
SELECT
  usage_date,
  dbx_user_group,
  dbx_user,
  COUNT(*) as questions_asked,
  COUNT(DISTINCT space_id) as spaces_used,
  MIN(event_time_local_tz) as first_seen,
  MAX(event_time_local_tz) as last_seen
FROM
  pivoted
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY usage_date, dbx_user_group, dbx_user

datasets.name: ds_query_performance
queryLines:
-- Query Performance over last year (dynamic)
SELECT
  workspace_id,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  executed_by_user_id,
  COUNT(*) as total_queries,
  ROUND(AVG(total_duration_ms) / 1000, 0) as avg_latency_s,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(total_duration_ms, 0.5) / 1000, 0) as p50_latency_s,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(total_duration_ms, 0.95) / 1000, 0) as p95_latency_s,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN execution_status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / COUNT(*),
    1
  ) as success_rate_pct,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN from_result_cache THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / COUNT(*),
    1
  ) as cache_hit_pct
FROM
  system.query.history
WHERE
  query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL
  AND workspace_id
    = (
      SELECT
        workspace_id
      FROM
        genie_usage
      LIMIT 1
    )
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
